incidents.name: BoJLeverageMarket
incidents.notes: Aave-v3-derived pool lets flash-loan fees inflate the cbBTC liquidity index while scaled supply is dust, overvaluing collateral for borrowing.

sources.ref: Recheck of the deployment basis (DELEGATECALL audit): the victim is an EIP-1967 proxy over an Aave-v3-style Pool; its implementation slot holds 0xf441a52fc1898febb78fba81eed3002cbb45d571 at both the creation block 32861311 and the incident block 33136656 with no intermediate write found by binary-searching eth_getStorageAt, and both the proxy and the implementation runtimes are byte-identical at those blocks. The implementation's fourteen DELEGATECALLs are linked-library constants (0x0e905c9fa92006c3c934e6ea15de85c0a8e10683, 0x9c6c8778c84ba0ae9858b0ce63cee62aae6591ee, 0x9eafbc7dcdcef5762ce353df033b70d6ff7ca94f, 0xa059a6c6ed25c221c32a41d7f457dd3b0807c5fa), all deployed by the same deployer minutes earlier and unchanged over the window.
